name: Zan.Ai
description: AI application pipeline for Zan: unified LLM client with retry/timeout/token accounting, OpenAI-compatible embeddings, document chunking, the tool-calling loop (registry/agent with async, sync and result-style implementations), and a bridge that plugs remote MCP tools into the local tool registry — the assembly line that turns documents into retrievable vectors

name: Zan.AppUpdate
description: Universal application updater, release packager, zip compression, progress tracking and MD5 tamper-detection self-healing for Zan

name: Zan.Barcode
description: Barcode and QR for Zan: the full QR Code model 1-40 codec (ISO/IEC 18004 - numeric/alphanumeric/byte segments, automatic version selection, Reed-Solomon over GF(256), mask penalty scoring) plus a scanner that reads QR codes back out of images (finder and alignment pattern detection, rotation and perspective correction, format-info BCH recovery, block de-interleaving and error correction) - pure Zan, no reflection, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Bench
description: Micro-benchmarking for Zan: warmup plus repeated measurement on a monotonic clock, median-led statistics (median/mean/min/max/stddev/ops-per-second), parameterized cases with type-preserving generics, text and JSON reports, and baseline comparison with a noise threshold - pure Zan, no reflection, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Bson
description: BSON for Zan: schemaless Pack/Unpack over System.Json.JsonValue covering double/string/document/array/binary (best-effort UTF-8)/ObjectId (24-hex)/bool/datetime (ISO 8601)/null/int32/int64 with canonical int-width selection and strict length validation — pure Zan little-endian wire format, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Caching
description: Caching for Zan: in-process LRU + TTL MemoryCache<T> (O(1) hit/evict, slot reuse, zero steady-state allocation, optional sliding expiration, opt-in mutex), a minimal IStringCache backend contract, and a two-layer read-through/write-through LayeredCache over it - pure Zan, monotonic-clock TTL, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Cbor
description: CBOR (RFC 8949) for Zan: definite-length encoding and full decode (including indefinite-length chunked strings/arrays/maps, tags 0/1 timestamps, half-float 0xf9) over System.Json.JsonValue — pure Zan IEEE-754 bit construction, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Cli
description: Terminal output toolkit for Zan: ANSI styling (16/256/truecolor), width-aware tables, progress bars and interactive prompts — pure Zan, rendering is pure functions

name: Zan.Commercial
description: [experimental] Commercial licensing client module for Zan

name: Zan.Csv
description: RFC 4180 CSV for Zan: quoted fields with embedded delimiters/newlines, CRLF/LF/CR records, UTF-8 BOM stripping, custom separators (TSV), table writer with minimal quoting — value model is plain string rows, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Data
description: Data access for Zan: the System.Data connection/pool core, the System.Data.ORM (ZanSql codegen ORM), native-wire drivers for MySql/Postgres/SqlServer/Sqlite/Firebird/TDengine/ODBC, Redis client, the embedded ZanDb document store, and Xlsx reading

name: Zan.DataFrame
description: Pure-Zan tabular data core: columnar DataFrame with type inference, filter/sort/groupby-agg/hash-join; CSV IO via Zan.Csv

name: Zan.Desktop
description: OS desktop and system integration for Zan: clipboard/tray icon/screen/message box (System.Windows), input hooks/hotkeys/mouse/keyboard (System.Input), audio playback (System.Media + the System.Audio compat entry), UI automation (System.Automation), drawing primitives and printing (System.Drawing), and WMI system information/registry/scheduler (System.Management)

name: Zan.Diagnostics
description: Process control, Windows service integration and server observability for Zan: spawn/control/list child processes, SCM service snapshots, privilege checks, structured logging, and request/SQL/slow-path metrics — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Game
description: 2D real-time game engine, scene graph and gameplay kits for Zan

name: Zan.Game.Animation
description: 3D animation runtime for Zan games: TRS transforms, bone hierarchies with bind pose and world pose, linear blend skinning, keyframe clips with per-channel sampling, a player with loop and speed control, a state machine with parameter-driven transitions and cross-fade, and analytic two-bone IK - pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Game.Assets
description: Asset runtime for Zan games: declarative manifests with dependency graphs, reference-counted loading with dependency tracking, deterministic LRU budget eviction, and grouped (scene-level) load/unload - pure Zan, zero reflection, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Game.Audio
description: Audio processing for Zan games: sample buffers, waveform synthesis with ADSR envelopes, biquad and one-pole filters, mixing, pitch shifting, and pure-Zan WAV read/write - deterministic, engine-agnostic, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Game.Common
description: Shared gameplay building blocks for Zan games: versioned key-value profile saves with atomic replace and backup restore, floating combat text, health bars with damage ghost, cooldowns with charges, inventory slots with stacking rules, and minimap projection - pure logic, headless-testable, no GUI dependency

name: Zan.Game.Debug
description: Game debug tooling for Zan games: a frame-profiling overlay and an entity inspector built on a strict data/draw split - the data layer turns profiler segments and caller-supplied entity snapshots into assertable row models (label, value, share, over-budget flag) with deterministic filtering and sorting, and the draw layer only turns those rows into Gui controls - pure Zan, no reflection, headless-testable, no GUI dependency in the data layer

name: Zan.Game.Ecs
description: Entity-component-system runtime for Zan games: typed component pools, deferred entity destruction, grouped system scheduling and stable-order queries — compile-time typed, zero runtime reflection

name: Zan.Game.Factory
description: Factory-automation and tower-defense simulation runtime for Zan games: grid world, conveyor logistics, recipes and power, tech tree research, wave spawning, combat resolution and versioned save/load — pure logic, no GUI dependency

name: Zan.Game.Netcode
description: Rollback netcode for Zan games: deterministic FNV-1a state checksums, ring-buffered world snapshots, per-frame input tracking with prediction, rollback-and-replay sessions with desync detection, and server-side lag compensation by rewinding position history - pure logic, headless-testable, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Game.Particles
description: Unified particle system for Zan games: pooled particles, rate/burst emitters, curve-driven size and color, deterministic noise turbulence — engine-agnostic and replay-safe

name: Zan.Game.Pathfinding
description: Grid pathfinding for Zan games: weighted A*, jump point search (JPS), line-of-sight string pulling and a rectangle navmesh with funnel smoothing — deterministic, zero reflection

name: Zan.Game.Physics2D
description: 2D rigid-body dynamics for Zan games: convex shapes, SAT narrowphase with speculative contacts, sequential-impulse solver with penetration correction and revolute/distance joints — deterministic, zero reflection

name: Zan.Game.Physics3D
description: 3D rigid-body dynamics for Zan games: sphere/box shapes, quaternion orientation, SAT narrowphase with speculative contacts, sequential-impulse solver with warm starting, friction cone and split-impulse penetration correction — deterministic, double precision, zero reflection

name: Zan.Game.Procgen
description: Procedural generation for Zan games: wave function collapse with weighted tiles and directional adjacency rules, level stitching by exit tags, and room-corridor dungeon layout via minimum spanning tree - deterministic, seeded, pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Game.Profiler
description: Frame profiling for Zan games: turns the prof corridor's per-frame segment bill into a stable, parseable contract (prof frame=... scope=... ms=...) with a strict parser, a frame-budget analyzer (percentiles, over-budget ratio, stutter runs, hotspot attribution) and text/JSON reports - pure logic, headless-testable, no GUI dependency, no engine dependency

name: Zan.Game.Render3D
description: 3D rendering pipeline for Zan games: an orbit/free camera with view and projection matrices, a transform scene graph, PBR-style material and multi-light parameters, CPU lighting (half-lambert plus Blinn-Phong specular), frustum sphere culling, deterministic draw ordering with mesh grouping, and post-process parameters (exposure, tonemap, fog) - the data layer is pure math and headless-testable, the thin draw layer submits batches to the Gui canvas

name: Zan.Globalization
description: Key-based localization (Lang, Apple .strings-style) and Lunar calendar with ganzhi/zodiac for Zan — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Gui
description: The Zan GUI toolkit: App/window shell, widget tree and control library (DataTable, Chart, ChatView, CodeEditor-free core), styling/skins, text shaping, media and the backend shells, with skins/icons/native driver bundles riding in src/Gui

name: Zan.Gui.Browser
description: In-app web browsers for Zan Gui: WebViewBox on the system WebView (WebView2/WebKitGTK) and CefBrowserBox on the Chromium Embedded Framework, with CDP control, cookie and fingerprint management

name: Zan.Gui.Charts
description: Rich 2D/3D business charts & data visualization suite for Zan GUI (Line, Bar, Pie, Scatter, Heatmap, Radar, Polar)

name: Zan.Gui.CodeEditor
description: Code editing and console components for Zan Gui: syntax-highlighted CodeEditor with completion/intellisense/debug integration, ChatView bubble chat, ConsoleView terminal, and read-only CodeBlock

name: Zan.Gui.DataTable
description: Enterprise data grid for Zan Gui: DataGrid/DataTable with column model, sorting/filtering (incl. filter builder and filter tree), computed cells, pivot/transpose, master-detail, transactions, HTTP/local data sources, xlsx export and multi-language UI

name: Zan.Gui.Themes
description: Curated visual skin packs (chinese, brutalism, darkgold, neon, etc.) for Zan GUI

name: Zan.Hosting
description: Application hosting for Zan: IHostedService lifecycle contract, BackgroundService periodic-loop base class (exception-tolerant loop, per-tick timing, cancellation on stop, bounded join), and AppHost ordered start / reverse-order stop with per-service stop timeout, failure accounting and a typed status snapshot - no reflection, no codegen, pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Image
description: Independent image decoding and ARGB32 caching for Zan (System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodec): PNG/JPEG/BMP/GIF/TGA/PNM/PSD/WebP, PNG-compressed ICO entries and SVG rasterization

name: Zan.Industrial
description: [experimental] Industrial HMI & SCADA components for Zan GUI (Gauges, Trends, Alarms, Equipment Panels)

name: Zan.IO
description: Extended I/O for Zan: Path helpers, text streams, memory/mapped streams, INI, known folders, shortcuts, directory trees, file watching, and the compression family (Zip/GZip/Deflate/BZip2/Tar/Crc32) — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Jobs
description: Background job queue for Zan: durable task store with an append-only event log and restart replay, explicit handler registration (no reflection), retry with exponential backoff and jitter, delayed and recurring schedules, dead-letter handling, and observable job state - pure Zan, single-process writer, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Json
description: JSON contract layer for Zan: JSON Schema validation (draft 2020-12 subset), JSONPath queries and RFC 6902 JSON Patch application over System.Json.JsonValue - pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Knowledge
description: [experimental] Designer knowledge base for Zan: gallery index shared by the CLI and MCP server — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Linq
description: LINQ-style sequence operators for Zan: Enumerable query extensions, expression trees (Expr/ExprNode), grouping and stream pipelines — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Mapping
description: Explicit object mapping for Zan: typed mapping profiles with named member rules and per-member error attribution, reusable value converters, and a code generator that turns compile-time entity metadata into plain mapping functions - pure Zan, no reflection, no boxing

name: Zan.Mcp
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) client for Zan: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP with the initialize handshake, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read and ping, bearer/api-key auth, structured error reporting and a pluggable transport - pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Messaging
description: In-process messaging for Zan: typed channels with publish/subscribe and command semantics, request-response endpoints that keep the result type intact, and a middleware pipeline with explicit error routing - pure Zan, no reflection, no runtime type names required

name: Zan.MsgPack
description: MessagePack for Zan: schemaless Pack/Unpack over System.Json.JsonValue covering nil/bool/int (fixint..int64)/float64/str/bin/array/map plus the timestamp extension — pure Zan IEEE-754 bit construction, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Mvc
description: [migration-in-progress] Enterprise Web MVC framework and admin console for Zan: controllers, ORM + cache, RBAC auth, job host, metrics, in-memory views

name: Zan.Net
description: Pure-Zan networking for Zan: TCP/UDP sockets, the managed TLS stack, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 client and server, reverse proxy and forwarder, WebSocket/WSS, SSE, MQTT, CoAP, Modbus, NTP, SIP, WebDAV, ping and NIC enumeration — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Oss
description: Object storage for Zan: Aliyun OSS (V1 signature), Tencent COS (XML API signature) and S3-compatible (AWS SigV4) — put/get/head/delete, streaming get-to-file, public URL and credential check, pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Pdf
description: PDF generation for Zan: composable pages with lines, rectangles and text, standard-14 font metrics for measurement and layout, tables with column widths and padding, and a PDF 1.4 writer with cross-reference table and document metadata - pure Zan, no native dependencies, no font embedding

name: Zan.Platform.Compat
description: [frozen] Backward compatibility forwarding package for legacy Platform.Runtime APIs

name: Zan.Protobuf
description: Protocol Buffers wire-format codec for Zan: varint/zigzag/length-delimited/fixed64/fixed32 fields, nested and packed messages, unknown-field skipping (including groups), IEEE-754 doubles via pure-Zan bit construction — no .proto schema, no codegen, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Resources
description: Resource packs for Zan: build and read bundled asset packs (ResourcePack/ResourcePackWriter) — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Scripting
description: In-process Lua 5.3/5.4 embedding for Zan (Lua/LuaValue) with the cross-platform native driver bundle — drivers auto-bundle on --publish

name: Zan.Sdk.Jd
description: JD open platform SDK for Zan

name: Zan.Sdk.Steam
description: Steam API SDK for Zan

name: Zan.Sdk.Wechat
description: WeChat official account, mini-program, work and pay SDK for Zan

name: Zan.Security
description: Pure-Zan cryptography for Zan: AES/SHA/MD5/HMAC/HKDF/PBKDF2, RSA/ECDSA/Curve25519/BigInt, the Chinese national SM2/SM3/SM4 suites, X.509 certificates, JWT and OTP — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Ssh
description: SSH for Zan: RFC 4251 wire codec, RFC 4253 binary packet protocol with AES-GCM, version exchange, algorithm negotiation, curve25519-sha256 key exchange (RFC 8731), host key fingerprints and known_hosts verification, password/publickey authentication and exec channels - pure Zan, reuses Zan.Security crypto primitives

name: Zan.Test
description: Lightweight test framework for Zan: non-aborting assertions (Equal/Nearly/Contains/Null/Throws over int/long/double/bool/string), an explicit-registration runner with setup/teardown, groups, skip, per-case timing and result recording, a deterministic ok/FAIL/skip + summary output contract, Report/Finish for CI exit codes, plus pytest-style fixtures (typed registration, explicit dependencies, function/module scope, autouse, teardown callbacks) and parameterized cases (per-type ParamInt/ParamString/ParamDouble/ParamBool delegates plus labelled TestCase lists) - no reflection, no codegen, pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Test.Fixtures
description: Deterministic fake data for Zan tests: seeded random primitives, semantic data (names, emails, addresses, sentences, colors, reserved test card numbers), random collections with uniqueness guarantees, and an explicit object-assembly builder - pure Zan, no reflection, reproducible from a seed

name: Zan.Test.Mocks
description: Interface test doubles and behavior verification for Zan without reflection or code generation: call recording with text-normalized arguments, argument matchers (any/eq/not-eq/contains/prefix/between), call-count expectations (exactly/at-least/at-most), a MockBase for hand-written fakes, stub sequences, action spies and async task stubs - pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Text
description: Text processing for Zan: Markdown renderer, pinyin conversion with bundled data table, BM25 full-text search, fuzzy matching, text templates and tables, and the regex engine — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Toml
description: TOML v1.0 parser and writer for Zan: tables, arrays of tables, dotted keys, all four string kinds, hex/oct/bin integers, floats, datetimes (as strings), inline tables and arrays — value tree is System.Json.JsonValue, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Validation
description: Declarative validation for Zan: rule chains, error aggregation, nested validation and JSON/text error views — compile-time bound property getters, zero runtime reflection

name: Zan.Web
description: Server web framework for Zan: WebApp/WebHost, Router, Controller and HTTP attributes, HttpContext, view rendering, validation, static files, API docs, menus, CSRF/rate-limit/permission plumbing, and WebSocket sessions — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Xml
description: XML DOM for Zan: recursive-descent parser (entities, CDATA, comments, PI, DOCTYPE), tree navigation with prefix-tolerant name lookup, and a compact/pretty writer with full round-trip — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Yaml
description: YAML core subset for Zan: block mappings/sequences with compact nesting, flow collections (multi-line), all four scalar kinds, literal/folded block scalars with chomping, anchors and aliases, core-schema typing (null/bool/int incl 0x/0o/float incl .inf/.nan) — value tree is System.Json.JsonValue, no native dependencies
